literal_meaning: ফুলে ওঠা বা উত্তপ্ত অবস্থার অনুকরণমূলক শব্দ (swelling or puffing up onomatopoeically)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সাফল্য পেয়ে তার তুমতুমি বেড়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: After getting rich, he is acting with arrogance.
His haughtiness has increased after success.
note: Often used to describe arrogance stemming from sudden wealth or status elevation in Bengali social contexts.
